name: Snakehead braised in coconut water
summary: The national rural tourism center’s English article names snakehead fish braised in coconut water among the coconut specialties prepared in the gardens, with coconut worms and coconut-heart salad. The article prints no Vietnamese name and no recipe. The Vietnamese name here is the usual name for that English line. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Coconut-garden cooking, on the national rural tourism center’s English article. No date was printed on the article.
howToEat: The article lists it as something you prepare on a garden visit, beside coconut worms and coconut-heart salad. No fish cut, no braise, and no hour were printed.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The coconut gardens the article names: Châu Thành, Giồng Trôm, Mỏ Cày Nam, Mỏ Cày Bắc, and Chợ Lách, including Cồn Phụng and Cồn Quy. No door was printed.
